desc: Formalize directed-edge DP: branch(v,u) = max(1, 1 + top-3 sum of branch(n,v) for neighbors n≠u); internal state valid only when v has >=3 other neighbors; degree-4 root uses top-4 incident branches (1 + top-4 sum).

Implement the O(N) rerooting DP (iterative two-pass message passing): bottom-up up[v] for child->parent branch values, top-down pm[v] for parent->child branch values with top-3 excluding current child via tracked top-4 candidate list per vertex.
Evaluate every vertex with >=4 neighbors as a degree-4 root using its top-4 incident branch values; output maximum size, or -1 if none exists.
Handle edge cases: N<5, star graph, path, trees where the only potential degree-4 vertex lacks enough selectable branches.
Run all three samples (8, -1, 11) — validated: PASSED all 3 public samples.
